records.meaning: One closed local registration naming an ontology, package root, exact material identity, source selectors, record sources, and native validator.
One deterministic content-addressed snapshot or a collect-all blocked result that preserves every discovered registration and source-currentness error.
One explicit ontology registration plus a declared reconcile intent that permits observation of drift and construction of a successor candidate, but not semantic repair, admission, or activation.

One immutable content-addressed candidate bundle containing exact source bytes, derived identities, validation evidence, causal residue, and a manifest that grants no active-registration or acceptance authority.
Read and execute only paths and validator arguments declared in the local registry; never discover or infer another package.

Never rewrite an admitted epoch or update its expected digest in place; publish any observed change as a distinct content-addressed candidate and require an exact owner decision before a later active-pointer switch.
Candidate exact binding from the generated system ontology to runtime.py.

Preserve exact registration and selector identity, deterministic snapshots, bounded retrieval, native-verdict fidelity, immutable admitted epochs, crash-safe candidate publication, no ontology-source writes, and authority_effect none.
The repository-local set of explicitly registered private ontology packages.

residue.meaning: The Ontology Product predecessor was reconciled to an append-only validated source epoch; the runtime must continue to preserve its exact native verdict.
The selected DomainSpec v2 profile is implementation-owned and development-only; release admission is not granted.
No owner acceptance binds the exact implementation postimage and system-ontology digest.
